sn19.14:1.1: _Maṅgura_ is a skin color, neither black nor brown, where the corresponding Sanskrit term is _madgura_, also spelled _maṅgura_. This is a species of fish, probably of a distinctive color, and later made into a caste of those who fish them. “Fishwife” seems to suit.
sn19.14:1.4: _Ikkhaṇikā_ is a “fortune teller” or “seer”. What she sees are _maṅgala_ (signs or auspicies), hence she is reborn as a _maṅguli_.
